subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should resetSession be an after-compaction-only hook capability or a generic API on PluginHookAgentContext?
rationale: The current type and run-context wiring establish a durable plugin contract beyond the PR's stated compaction use case, so code review alone cannot choose the intended public surface.

options.title: After-compaction only
options.body: Expose the method only while dispatching after_compaction and keep queue ownership in the outer run or compaction lifecycle.

options.title: Generic embedded hook API
options.body: Approve resetSession for broader embedded hooks and add documentation, loop protections, and tests for every context where it is available.

recommendation.title: After-compaction only
recommendation.body: Expose the method only while dispatching after_compaction and keep queue ownership in the outer run or compaction lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent compaction and hook-context work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the API-scope decision.
